reasons.plausibility: Cold-rolling a powder feedstock is physically impossible; the hypothesis confuses powder processing with bulk deformation, and the proposed mechanism (recrystallization of a powder) is not scientifically sound.
reasons.testability: The test is described in general terms (comparative study, measure properties/stresses) but cannot be executed as written because the starting state (cold-rolled powder) is undefined and unachievable.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it proposes an inapplicable intervention for a powder feedstock, failing to address the core challenge of additive manufacturing of miniature components.
